x.healthWarn: These modes give general tips only. They do not replace your doctor or change your medicine.

md.diabetes: Watch carbs per meal, pair them with protein, no fasting. Check your glucose as your doctor says.
md.hypertension: Salt limit: 1,500 mg of sodium a day. Fewer canned and cured foods.
md.cholesterol: More fiber, oats and beans; fewer fried foods and saturated fat.
md.cycle: Log your period to know your next cycle and adjust energy.
md.pregnancy: No calorie deficit, no fasting. About +300 kcal from the 2nd trimester. Follow your doctor.

x.kidRule: Kids: no calorie counting, only healthy habits.
